snippet.title: Separated - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Separated across two abandoned houses, you and your friend have to communicate your way out. But don't get comfortable, a blind entity listens to your conversations!

Check out the demo on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2976110/Separated/

Edited by: Miguel Penariol
Recorded by: @okdipstick & @zoomzoomZZ
Poster by: Vitor Ximenez

Separated is created by Twisted Realm.
